content: Tsa'ma Chiga Tisei'ccu ca'nimba tsangae opatsse can'jeñe ñoa'me su'cho toya pasambi'te jinge dyoe'sui'ccu Tise've in'jan'faye. Injama'tse, majan que'i'su shacasi israendeccuma se'piqquia'caen Chiga que'ima'qque ca'niñe se'pisa'ne.
Nane Jesucristone ñotsse condase'choma candusiansi ingi'qque paña'fa. Tayopi'su a'i'qque tsa'caen Chiga Aya'fama paña'ma chi'gasi tsa Aya'faja tise'pama fuitembi opatsse can'jeña'chonga ca'ni'faye.
Tsa'ma ingija pañamba gi ca'ni'faya Chigai'ccu tsangae opatsse canseye. Nane Chigaja in'jambindeqquiane qquen su:

content.text: In'jambisi Ñajan tise'pama iyicca'yepa ñoa'me su'choi'ccu su:
“Tsendeccuja Ñai'ccu ca'ni'faya'bi tsu tsangae opatsse canseye.”

content: Qquen supa tsu opatsse can'jeña'chone conda. Nane me'ttia'ye andeve agattointe Chigaja tsa'caen antte cuintsu aindeccu ca'ni'faye.
Tsane tsu cca'tti Chiga Tevaen'jenga qquen su:

content.text: Seis a'tangae Chigaja pa'tssi Tise in'jan'chove agattoen nanimba

content: Qquen susi gi in'jan'fa Chigaja antte a'i Tisei'ccu tsangae opatsse can'jen'faye.

Tsa'caen tayopi'su israendeccuja Moisési'ccu jacamba Chiga Aya'fama paña'ma chi'gapa ca'ni'fambi Chigai'ccu tsangae opatsse canseye. Tsa'ma Chiga ñoa'me su'cho toya pasambisi majan pañasundeccuja toya tsu ca'niña'cho.
Tsa'cansi ccase tsu Chigaja ca'niña'cho a'tane condase, “Ja'ño a'ta” qquen supa. Nane omboe tsa tayopi'su Davidma in'jaensi tsu tayo conda'cho Chiga Tevaen'jeni qquen su:

Nane Josuéja tayopi majan israendeccuma Canaán andenga ca'niansi tsendeccuja Chigai'ccu tsangae opatsse canseya'chonga ñoa'me ca'ni'fambi. Ñoa'me tseni Chigai'ccu ca'nimba tsangae opatsse can'jen'fa'choecan'da tsu Chigaja omboe ccase: “Ja'ño a'ta ca'niña'cho” qquen condambiye'can.
Tsa'cansi ja'ño toya tsu Chigaja in'jan cuintsu Tise aindeccuja Tisei'ccu tsangae opatsse canse'faye.
Chigaja osha'chove agattoen nanimba opatsse can'jemba dyai. Tsa'cansi ingi'qque Tisenga ca'nimba can'jemba Tisia'caen semañe antte'fa.

Tsa'camba jinge Chiga in'janqquia'caen tson'faye Tisei'ccu tsangae opatsse canseye. Nane tayopi'su a'ija Chiga su'choma paña'ma Chiga in'jambi'choa've tson'fa. Tsa'caen tsomba Chigama cati'fa. Que'i'qque tsa'caen tson'fajama, tise'pa'caen egae tsincomba Chigama catisa'ne.

Nane Chiga Aya'faja quinsetssipa tsu osha'choma oshacho. Matichi ñoa'me tsuintssiai'ccu nama, tsu'ttama'qque doñamba attianqquia'caen tsu Chiga Aya'faja ingi injama'chonga ca'nimba ti'tsse pa'ccoma attian. Nane pa'cco ingi injama'cho in'jan'choma in'jamba tsu attian. Ñoa'me ingi injama'cho tsosipie asi'ttaen'choma'qque tsu a'tatsse attian.

Nane Tisenga gi pa'cco ingi tson'chone tansintsse condase'faya'cho. Tiseja poiyi'cco Tise agattoensi jincho'choma atesuchopa caña'jen'nijan ¿ma'caen gi a'tu'faya? Nane Tisenejan osha'cho tsu chu'cco ccuiqquia'caen a'tatsse attian'fa.

Jesúsja Chiga Dutssi'yepa joccapitssia ingine Chigama afa'su tsu. Tiseja sefacconi ansundepa tansintsse Chiga Quitsanga ja. Tsa'cansi ingija Jesúsnga ca'ni'fa qquen su'ta jinge anttembe'yi tise've in'jamba canse'faye.

Nane ingine Chigama afa'su tsu ingi qque'choma atesupa ingima mende'yeye osha. Tise'qque ingia'caen a'ive dapa can'jensi Satanajan tisema'qque qqueña qquen tson. Tsa'camba Jesúsja egae tsincon'choma patsu'a'qque tsu ingi qque'choma injan'jen.

Tsa'caen Jesús ingima mende'ye'ninda jinge dyombi'tsse Chigama iñajan'faye. Nane Chigaja ingima ñotsse tsoñe in'jamba tsu ingima mende'yeya. Tsa'cansi gi Tisema dyombi'tsse iñajan'faya'cho. Nane maqui ingi vana'jen'ninda tse'faei'ccuyi tsu Tiseja ingima ñotsse tsomba fuiteya.
